exercises.prompt: 仿写本句(替换主语或表语):In the end, the obsession with a high score may fade, and the real gain may be a clear head and a steady hand.
exercises.answer: In the end, the obsession with a high score may fade, and the real gain may be a clear head and a steady hand.
exercises.note: 结尾升华:从分数转向能力的成长,是作文收束的常用手法。

lessonGrammar.name: hand in
lessonGrammar.note: hand in 表示「上交(作业)」。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: In our writing class, we may hand in one essay each week, and the teacher may mark every draft with a careful note.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 在我们的写作课上,我们可能每周交一篇作文,而老师可能给每份草稿留下细致的批注。

lessonGrammar.name: not...but... 结构
lessonGrammar.note: not A but B 表示「不是 A,而是 B」,是考研作文表达观点的经典句式。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The mark of a good essay is not a long word or a fancy phrase, but a clear structure and a steady argument.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 一篇好作文的标志不是生僻的词或花哨的短语,而是清晰的结构和稳健的论证。

lessonGrammar.name: 作文句式
lessonGrammar.note: 先否定再肯定的句式(A is not X but Y)是议论文立论的常用开头。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: The mark of a good essay is not a long word or a fancy phrase, but a clear structure and a steady argument.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 一篇好作文的标志不是生僻的词或花哨的短语,而是清晰的结构和稳健的论证。

lessonGrammar.name: 冒号解释说明
lessonGrammar.note: 冒号后具体列出三个部分的句式,one 指代 one pattern。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: We may learn a useful pattern for each part of the essay: one for the opening, one for the body, and one for the conclusion.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 我们可以为作文的每个部分学习一个有用的句式:开头一个,主体一个,结尾一个。

lessonGrammar.name: 省略结构
lessonGrammar.note: one for the opening 是 one pattern for the opening 的省略。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: We may learn a useful pattern for each part of the essay: one for the opening, one for the body, and one for the conclusion.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 我们可以为作文的每个部分学习一个有用的句式:开头一个,主体一个,结尾一个。
